title: Stage 3: Config and secrets
summary: Hand the API its settings and the database password without baking them into the image.

steps.title: The API's configuration
body: password: czNjcjN0UEBzcw==    # (created by the pipeline from the vault, never committed)
valueFrom: { secretKeyRef: { name: shop-db, key: username } }
valueFrom: { secretKeyRef: { name: shop-db, key: password } }
The same Secret feeds the database: the postgres image reads `POSTGRES_USER` and `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` on first start.

steps.prompt: ASP.NET Core reads `Db__Host` from the environment. Which configuration key does the app see?
steps.explain: `__` maps to `:` because `:` is not allowed in environment variable names on every platform.

buckets: Neither: leave it out of the cluster config
steps.explain: The image tag belongs in the Deployment (the template), so changing it triggers a rollout.

steps.prompt: The pipeline rotates the database password in the Secret. The API pods use `secretKeyRef` env vars. What else must happen?
options: Restart the API pods (`kubectl rollout restart deploy/shop-api`) so they read the new value, and change the password in PostgreSQL itself
steps.explain: Env vars are read at process start. The database also needs `ALTER USER`; the postgres image only uses `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` when initialising an empty data directory.

steps.title: Build the connection string
prompt: Write `string ConnectionString(Dictionary<string, string> configMap, Dictionary<string, string> secretData)` that builds what the API would assemble from its environment:

`secretData` holds **base64** values, as in the YAML. If a required key is missing from either map, throw `KeyNotFoundException` with the missing key name as the message (check `Db__Host`, `Db__Name`, `username`, `password` in that order).
Also write `string Safe(string connectionString)` that replaces the password value with `***` for logging.
starter: string ConnectionString(Dictionary<string, string> configMap, Dictionary<string, string> secretData)
solution: string ConnectionString(Dictionary<string, string> configMap, Dictionary<string, string> secretData)
string Need(Dictionary<string, string> map, string key) =>
map.TryGetValue(key, out var v) ? v : throw new KeyNotFoundException(key);
template: Dojo.Try("builds without throwing", () => { dojoCs = ConnectionString(dojoCm, dojoSec); });
Dojo.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>("missing password throws", () => ConnectionString(dojoCm, new Dictionary<string, string> { ["username"] = "c2hvcA==" }));
try { ConnectionString(new Dictionary<string, string> { ["Db__Host"] = "x" }, dojoSec); } catch (KeyNotFoundException e) { dojoMsg = e.Message; }
Dojo.Eq("message names the missing key", "Db__Name", dojoMsg);
hints: A small local helper `Need(map, key)` that throws keeps it tidy.
For `Safe`, split on `;`, replace the part that starts with `Password=`, join again.
